name: InspectorToggleSwitch
label: Inspector toggle switch
description: One-row switch for inspector panels, where the whole bar toggles and the track sits at its end.

props.name: label
props.description: The setting's name, drawn inside the bar on the left. Also the switch's accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size, matching Button: `default` is 40px tall, `compact` 32px (not the native character-width `size` attribute).

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the checked state directly.
Fires alongside `onChange`, which keeps the standard React event signature.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the bar rather than the <input>.
